notes: Retail prices come ONLY from retailers' own websites (fetched automatically, with URL and retrieval time), your own bills (current plan), or quotes you type in from a retailer's site. Comparison sites are never used as a price source.
All prices are stored GST-inclusive. Prices published excluding GST are converted by adding 15%.

Most Auckland retailers show prices only after an address / ICP lookup. Prices are read only from ordinary public pages and published files a visitor would load; where the retailer's own public price page for the property is an ordinary HTML page (Meridian), it is read for one Vector-network Auckland property (rates stored as "Vector network, Auckland"; the address itself is never stored here). A quote app's internal (undocumented) API, session IDs issued by it, or keys copied from page scripts are never used. Retailers whose quote needs one of those, a login, personal details, or is blocked by robots.txt are listed as "needs manual quote" with the reason and their quote page.
Retailers closed to new customers are listed (with the reason) but their plans are never ranked.
Vector network (lines) charges are included as context only: they are part of every retail price, not a plan you can buy.
Low-user (low fixed charge) plans are being phased out: see lowFixedCharge for the rule and its source.
